name: Warped-Area Sampling
definition: An unbiased method for differentiable rendering that avoids explicit boundary sampling by reparameterizing the boundary integral into an interior integral using a continuous warp field V, based on the divergence theorem.
summary: Warped-Area Sampling is an unbiased differentiable rendering method that eliminates explicit boundary sampling by reparameterizing boundary integrals into interior integrals using a continuous warp field.
